purpose: make sure the system has the capacity it will need before demand arrives, at a cost the business accepts
entry_criteria: Demand forecasts or growth data exist
Current utilization and performance data exist
Capacity limits of the system are known (stage 92)
procedure: Collect demand and utilization trends and the business events that will change them (launches, campaigns, seasons).
Convert forecast demand into resource needs using measured capacity per unit, with a stated safety margin.
Find the first resource to run out for each scenario and the lead time to add more.
Decide actions with owners and dates: scale, optimize, order, or accept risk; compare cost options.
Alert when utilization approaches the planning threshold, with enough warning for the lead time.
Review forecast against actuals each period and correct the model.
acceptance_criteria: Each scenario names the first resource to run out
Safety margin and lead times are stated
validation_method: Service owner and finance review of the plan.

validation.check: compare last quarter's forecast with actual peak load
check each alert threshold leaves time for the lead time to add capacity

failure_modes.response: Alert earlier or reserve in advance

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Peak traffic is forecast to rise 40 percent for the holiday season. Load tests show the database saturates first; the plan adds a read replica two weeks before and sets an alert at 70 percent database CPU.
